column1: # onefold file-type registry. ONE row per extension (lowercase, no dot). Columns:
# ext  kind  category  group  format  canonical  flags  description
# kind = extraction pipeline; category = fine taxonomy; group = layout family ({group});

# photo/video kinds are FROZEN to the media contract = the golden scope (ADR 0002): photo = jpg jpeg heic heif avif png webp tif tiff + camera RAW (group RAW, minus the nksc sidecar and the eip package); video = mov mp4 mkv avi 3gp webm flv wmv mpg mpeg m4v; other video containers are kind "other", group VIDEO.
# canonical is FROZEN to jpeg/jpe->jpg tif->tiff htm->html yml->yaml mpeg->mpg: it names golden files ({ext-norm}); a new alias renames existing golden trees.
# format = parser/container id (dispatch + magic family); canonical = harmonized extension;
# flags = system (OS artifact), common (frequent file types), personal (typical personal files), transient (incomplete downloads, temp and lock files), shortcut (links to other files or sites).
